Best value under ₹50,000: the MSI Modern 14 at about ₹43,219 with all three picks having 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD.

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM / SSD	Display
MSI Modern 14 C7M	about ₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16GB / 512GB	14" FHD IPS
Acer Aspire 14 AI	about ₹43,999	Snapdragon X	16GB / 512GB	14" WUXGA 120Hz
Lenovo ThinkBook 16 Gen 7	about ₹46,990	Ryzen 5 7535HS	16GB DDR5 / 512GB	16" 16:10 FHD+
MSI: the cheapest and light at about 1.4kg, but the battery is smaller and stock can be patchy.
Acer: about 15 hours of battery and the best screen, but some apps may not run on Windows on Arm.
Lenovo: the fastest chip, and the RAM and SSD can be upgraded, but it weighs about 1.7kg and the screen is dim.

These prices and specs come from one review site (SahiGadget, Oct 2026) that did not test the laptops itself. Prices change often, so check them on Amazon or Flipkart before buying.
